title: Share the joy of dance with a gift card
lead: A Fuego Dance School gift card is the perfect present for someone who wants to learn Bachata – or for yourself. Choose any amount and let them book courses, workshops and parties with us in Gothenburg.
posterAlt: Fuego Dance School gift card – share the joy of dance
benefits: Choose any amount – for example 1,000, 2,000 or 3,000 SEK
Valid for courses, workshops and parties
Perfect for birthdays, holidays or anyone who loves to dance
Valid at Fuego Dance School in Gothenburg
howSteps: Buy the gift card online through our secure checkout
Pick a set amount or enter your own
The recipient uses the balance when booking
seoH2: Gift card for dance courses in Gothenburg
seoBody: Looking for a gift card for a Bachata course in Gothenburg? At Fuego Dance School you can give a flexible balance that can be used for Bachata Sensual courses, workshops and social dance nights. Ideal for beginners and experienced dancers alike.
